description:
Paste your CV and one job ad. In a single run, Job Fit & Tailor gives you an honest, evidence-based application package:

1. A fit grade (A to F) and score, with a one line verdict.
2. Matched evidence: every requirement of the ad paired with the exact line of your CV that supports it.
3. Honest gaps: everything the ad asks for that your CV does not support, each with a practical suggestion (learn it, reframe it from real experience, or skip this ad).
4. A tailored CV, restructured and reworded for this specific ad, built ONLY from facts, roles, skills, and numbers already in your CV.
5. A change log listing every substantive change, so you can audit the tailoring line by line.
6. A short cover note and five likely interview questions with preparation tips grounded in your CV.
7. ATS keywords from the ad, split into present in your CV and missing.

The honesty guarantee: this app never fabricates or embellishes experience, skills, employers, dates, or metrics, and it never teaches keyword stuffing or ATS tricks. Unsupported requirements go to the gap list, never into your CV. If the fit is weak, the app says so and tells you whether reframing, learning, or skipping the ad is the honest move.

Three presets keep the first run effortless: corporate, startup, and internship.

Who it is for: early-career applicants, internship seekers, career switchers, and anyone applying across borders who wants to know, before spending an evening on an application, whether the fit is real and how to present true experience at its best.

Privacy: your CV text is processed to produce this run's result. It is not sold, shared, or used to train anything.

Ringkasan Bahasa Indonesia: Tempel CV Anda dan satu iklan lowongan. Dalam satu kali jalan, aplikasi ini memberi nilai kecocokan (A sampai F) dengan bukti baris CV, daftar celah yang jujur, CV yang disesuaikan hanya dari fakta di CV Anda lengkap dengan catatan perubahannya, surat pengantar singkat, dan lima pertanyaan interview yang mungkin muncul. Aplikasi ini tidak pernah mengarang pengalaman, dan syarat yang tidak didukung CV masuk daftar celah, bukan ke CV Anda.
name: Job Fit & Tailor
tagline: Score your CV against one job ad, see the evidence and the gaps, and get a tailored CV that never invents experience.
